parameters.content:
## WORKFLOW 2: CONCEPT APPROVAL GATES

Webhook POST /ugc-concept-approval
Payload: { project_id, action, concept_ids, notes }

Actions:
- pm_approve: PM approves concepts -> notify client
- pm_reject: PM rejects -> notify strategist team
- client_approve: Client approves -> trigger Workflow 3
- client_reject: Client rejects -> notify PM

This workflow handles the multi-stage approval
flow that saves tokens by only writing scripts
for approved concepts.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { body: { project_id: 'rec_TEST_123', action: 'pm_approve', concept_ids: [], notes: 'All looks great' } } }];

parameters.content:
## PM APPROVE BRANCH
Update approved concepts -> Update project status
-> Notify client for review

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'pm_approve', project_id: $json.project_id, approved_concepts: $json.approved_count, message: 'Concepts approved by PM. Client notified for review.' }) }}

parameters.content:
## PM REJECT BRANCH
Update concepts with revision status
-> Store PM notes -> Notify strategist team

parameters.text: ={{ `PM rejected concepts for ${$('Merge Context').first().json.project.brand_name || 'project'}. Revision notes: ${$('Merge Context').first().json.notes || 'No notes provided'}. Please review and update concepts in Airtable.` }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'pm_reject', project_id: $('Merge Context').first().json.project_id, message: 'Concepts sent back for revision. Strategist team notified.' }) }}

parameters.content:
## CLIENT APPROVE BRANCH
Update concepts -> Update project status to Scripting
-> Auto-trigger Workflow 3 (Script Writing)
-> Notify team

parameters.text: ={{ `Client approved ${$('Prepare Workflow 3 Trigger').first().json.approved_count} concepts for ${$('Prepare Workflow 3 Trigger').first().json.brand_name}. Script writing started automatically.` }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'client_approve', project_id: $('Prepare Workflow 3 Trigger').first().json.project_id, approved_concepts: $('Prepare Workflow 3 Trigger').first().json.approved_count, message: 'Client approved concepts. Script writing workflow triggered.' }) }}

parameters.content:
## CLIENT REJECT BRANCH
Update concepts -> Store client notes
-> Notify PM with client feedback

parameters.text: ={{ `Client requested revisions on concepts for ${$('Merge Context').first().json.project.brand_name || 'project'}. Client feedback: ${$('Merge Context').first().json.notes || 'No specific notes'}. Please review in Airtable and update concepts.` }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'client_reject', project_id: $('Merge Context').first().json.project_id, message: 'Client feedback stored. PM notified for concept revision.' }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'error', message: 'Unknown action. Use pm_approve, pm_reject, client_approve, or client_reject.' }) }}
